verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a first-party Treasury API reference exists (docs.stripe.com/api/treasury/financial_accounts), with machine-readable markdown docs and llms.txt. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec for tooling, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
